test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All heads are tails.

All tails are bones. 

**Conclusions:**

I. All bones are heads.

II. All heads are bones.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statements:

All heads are tails.

All tails are bones. 

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c800f43cd23d87efbb2173f27d163940d90b83c00b1dcd00464823187248fa3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bones are heads → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. All heads are bones → True (Because all heads are tails and all tails are bones so all heads are definitely bones)

Hence, “**Only conclusion II follows**” is the correct answer.
